context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Redis Role for Multi-OS Fleet.

checklist.name: Role variable prefix
checklist.description: All custom variables are prefixed with `redis_` (e.g., `redis_port`, `redis_max_memory`, `redis_bind`) — no unprefixed variable names like `port` or `max_memory`

checklist.name: include_vars for OS-specific
checklist.description: The tasks include a step using `ansible.builtin.include_vars` (or equivalent) to load OS-specific variable files, and separate `vars/Debian.yml` and `vars/RedHat.yml` files exist

checklist.name: dnf for RHEL, apt for Debian
checklist.description: RHEL/CentOS package installation uses `ansible.builtin.dnf` (not `ansible.builtin.yum`), and Debian/Ubuntu uses `ansible.builtin.apt`

checklist.name: Complete role directory files
checklist.description: The output includes at least: `tasks/main.yml`, `handlers/main.yml`, `defaults/main.yml`, `vars/main.yml`, and `meta/main.yml`

checklist.name: Service restart via handler
checklist.description: Config file deployment uses `notify:` to trigger a Redis restart handler rather than a direct restart task

checklist.name: FQCN modules used
checklist.description: All module references in task files use FQCN

checklist.name: All tasks have name field
checklist.description: Every task has a `name:` field

checklist.name: Tags on tasks
checklist.description: Tasks include `tags:` fields using appropriate categories (e.g., `install`, `configure`)

checklist.name: Defaults file has overridable vars
checklist.description: `defaults/main.yml` contains the redis port and max memory variables with default values (so they can be overridden by callers)

checklist.name: Boolean true/false syntax
checklist.description: All boolean values use `true` or `false`, not `yes` or `no`
